## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; leadership is Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Major short-vs-medium divergences among large caps warrant restraint and suppress strong directional calls.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials leading: NEM (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +21.26%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: SLB (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +33.42%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +14.77%) ABOVE TREND. Technology momentum: META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication lagging: Communication (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -4.84%) showing weakness. Healthcare mixed with pockets of stress: UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND, ABT (1W: -10.62% | 1M: -12.81%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate tepid: PSA (1W: -2.62% | 1M: +5.96%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND; GM (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +4.22%) ABOVE TREND; SLB (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +33.42%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PSA (1W: -2.62% | 1M: +5.96%) CORRECTION; ORCL (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -11.20%) BELOW TREND; GE (1W: -4.76% | 1M: -5.98%) BELOW TREND; TGT (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +7.84%) CORRECTION; COF (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -12.55%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select cyclicals and mid-cap pockets.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: GILD (1W: +13.56%), META (1W: +11.40%), GM (1W: +11.01%), SLB (1W: +9.06%), AMD (1W: +8.67%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: AAPL (1W: +4.69% | 1M: -5.68%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +5.73% | 1M: -1.52%) RECOVERY and NVDA (1W: +5.87% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY — tactical watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but positive on the week: META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +1.39%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -11.20%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -9.53% | 1M: +21.49%) CORRECTION highlight dispersion. Sector up 1W (+3.12%) but monitor 1M divergences.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials show internal weakness despite small 1W gain: JPM (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -8.36%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -8.41%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -10.05%) BELOW TREND — sector showing internal rotation rather than leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare bifurcated: GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +8.02%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND versus UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND, ABT (1W: -10.62% | 1M: -12.81%) BELOW TREND; sector showing internal rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to cyclical leaders and energy/materials (SLB, NEM, GM) while maintaining selective growth exposure to META and AMD; reduce exposure to large Healthcare names under pressure (UNH, ABT, CVS). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given broad sector participation and large-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND; SLB (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +33.42%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND; ABT (1W: -10.62% | 1M: -12.81%) BELOW TREND; CVS (1W: -9.36% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +4.37%) and Energy (1W: +3.57%) for continuation of cyclical leadership; Technology momentum to watch for confirmation. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -4.84%) and select Healthcare names at risk if negative news persists.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (RECOVERY) to hold weekly gains for a move back toward its 1M bias; AAPL (RECOVERY) must sustain 1W strength to confirm reversal versus 1M weakness; UNH (BELOW TREND) breaking further weekly support would extend selling pressure; SLB (ABOVE TREND) holding above recent breakout levels would signal continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GILD (+65): Trodelvy combo phase-3 win — GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. GE (+80): Vernova outlook lift — GE (1W: -4.76% | 1M: -5.98%) BELOW TREND, sentiment diverging and warrants watch for follow-through. JNJ (+60): upbeat guidance — JNJ (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +8.02%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GM (-50): headline on EV losses contrasts with rally — GM (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +4.22%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment diverging. CVS (-50): antitrust/media scrutiny aligns with sharp drop — CVS (1W: -9.36% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. UNH (-45): Medicare membership concerns match price stress — UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND and SLB (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +33.42%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND and ABT (1W: -10.62% | 1M: -12.81%) BELOW TREND are clear weak spots. Key risk is MAJOR DIVERGENCE among mega-caps (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA RECOVERY) versus several large Healthcare names BELOW TREND and mixed news-confirmation.
